# Agent Data Tools x402

> Eight same-origin pay-per-call tools for autonomous agents.

Canonical origin: https://pa-entity-x402.floot.app
Protocol: x402 v2
Network: Base mainnet (eip155:8453)
Asset: Base USDC
Payout: 0x708f7b52b56eafd7fc1de65fc7752ed732914021
OpenAPI: https://pa-entity-x402.floot.app/openapi.json
Canonical x402 discovery: https://pa-entity-x402.floot.app/.well-known/x402

## Paid tools

1. GET /_api/pa-entity-one?q=NAME — $0.001
   One highest-ranked Pennsylvania legal-entity match.

2. GET /_api/pa-business?q=NAME&limit=N — $0.005
   Up to 25 enriched Pennsylvania registry candidates.

3. GET /_api/vendor-intake-gate?name=NAME&address=ADDRESS&domain=DOMAIN — $0.020
   Fail-closed workflow decision returning proceed or human_review using PA registry identity, Census address consistency, OFAC candidate-name screening, and authoritative RDAP evidence.

4. GET /_api/sec-filings?ticker=AAPL&form=10-K&limit=1 — $0.005
   Authoritative recent SEC EDGAR filing metadata by ticker or CIK.

5. GET /_api/us-address-geocode?address=ADDRESS — $0.005
   Official U.S. Census address match, coordinates, and geography identifiers.

6. GET /_api/ofac-sdn-screen?name=NAME&limit=3&minScore=90 — $0.005
   OFAC SDN candidate-name screening. No-match is not sanctions clearance; no 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis.

7. GET /_api/domain-rdap?domain=DOMAIN — $0.005
   Authoritative domain-registration metadata discovered through IANA RDAP bootstrap.

8. GET /_api/treasury-average-rates?security=FILTER — $0.005
   Latest monthly average interest rates on outstanding U.S. Treasury securities from Fiscal Data.

## Payment behavior

An unpaid request returns an x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge.

After a payment signature is supplied, input is validated before verifier work. Payment is verified, the authoritative source is queried, and settlement occurs only after a usable result exists.

If the authoritative source fails, the request returns an upstream error and payment is not settled.

If verification or settlement is temporarily unresolved, retry the same authorization. Do not create a new payment merely because of a transient retry response.

## Vendor-intake gate

The gate returns:
- decision=proceed + agentAction=continue_vendor_intake, or
- decision=human_review + agentAction=pause_and_request_human_review.

It fails closed for missing/ambiguous/incomplete PA registry evidence, incomplete Census/OFAC/RDAP evidence, address mismatch, OFAC candidate names, unregistered domains, or vendor/domain name misalignment.

Proceed is only a workflow signal. It is not legal/compliance approval, sanctions clearance, fraud/credit approval, proof of current good standing, or proof of address/domain ownership.

## Sources

- Pennsylvania Department of State via data.pa.gov
- U.S. Census Bureau Geocoding Services
- U.S. Treasury OFAC Sanctions List Service
- IANA RDAP bootstrap + authoritative registry RDAP
- U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission EDGAR
- U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data

## Payment contract

All paid routes use x402 v2 on Base USDC.

Unpaid:
- challenge is returned before arbitrary source work
- PAYMENT-REQUIRED advertises exact amount/network/asset/payTo

Paid attempt:
1. decode payment authorization
2. validate request input
3. verify authorization
4. fetch authoritative source data / produce decision
5. settle only after a usable result exists

Authoritative-source failure:
- no settlement
- upstream error returned

Verifier or settlement uncertainty:
- retrySamePayment semantics
- no fresh payment challenge for settlement_pending / duplicate / indeterminate states
- retry the same PAYMENT-SIGNATURE

Success:
- PAYMENT-RESPONSE
- x402-settled:true
- paid:true

## Vendor-gate fail-closed rules

Automatic continuation requires exactly one strong PA legal-entity match with complete core identity evidence.

Submitted and registry Census responses must satisfy their evidence contract. The normalized primary street number and ZIP must match and coordinate distance must remain within the configured threshold.

OFAC evidence must satisfy the configured query/threshold/count/source contract. Any candidate at or above the review threshold triggers human review.

RDAP evidence must match the requested domain, include a boolean registration result, identify an authoritative RDAP endpoint and source, confirm registration, and plausibly align the hostname with the vendor name.

Proceed is only a workflow signal. It is not legal/compliance approval, sanctions clearance, fraud or credit approval, proof of good standing, or proof of address/domain ownership.

- U.S. Treasury OFAC Sanctions List Service
- IANA RDAP bootstrap and authoritative registry RDAP servers
- U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission EDGAR

# Agent Data Tools x402

Use this service when an agent needs low-cost authoritative public-data lookups or a bounded Pennsylvania vendor-intake workflow decision.

## Endpoints and prices

- /_api/pa-entity-one — $0.001 — Pennsylvania registry best match
- /_api/pa-business — $0.005 — Pennsylvania enriched multi-result search
- /_api/vendor-intake-gate — $0.020 — proceed/human_review vendor-intake decision
- /_api/sec-filings — $0.005 — SEC EDGAR recent filings
- /_api/us-address-geocode — $0.005 — Census address geocoding
- /_api/ofac-sdn-screen — $0.005 — OFAC SDN candidate-name screening
- /_api/domain-rdap — $0.005 — authoritative domain RDAP
- /_api/treasury-average-rates — $0.005 — Treasury monthly average rates

All prices are USDC on Base via x402 v2.

## Selection guidance

Choose /_api/vendor-intake-gate when an agent needs an action decision rather than raw source records.

Choose the underlying raw endpoints when the agent needs source facts directly or wants to perform its own decision policy.

The vendor gate calls its evidence-source logic internally and does not create nested seller-funded x402 purchases.

## Safety and interpretation

OFAC output is candidate-name screening only. A match is not a legal determination; a no-match is not sanctions clearance; ownership analysis under the OFAC 50 Percent Rule is not performed.

PA registry records do not independently prove current good standing, ownership, or authority to contract.

Census geocoding does not prove physical presence or control of an address.

RDAP registration and name alignment do not prove domain ownership or control.

Treasury average-interest-rate data are monthly averages on outstanding debt, not live market yields.

SEC filing metadata are authoritative EDGAR identifiers and dates, not investment advice or a claim about filing contents.

## Payment recovery

If a source fails before a usable result, payment is not settled.

If settlement is unresolved, retry the same request with the same PAYMENT-SIGNATURE rather than generating a fresh authorization.
